title: Exercise employee stock options
summary: When an option holder requests an exercise or a grant approaches a relevant exercise deadline. A verified exercise decision and, if completed, reconciled payment, issued equity and required reporting evidence.
outcomes: A verified exercise decision and, if completed, reconciled payment, issued equity and required reporting evidence.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When an option holder requests an exercise or a grant approaches a relevant exercise deadline.

parts.title: Reconcile the grant and the exercise request
parts.guidance: Gather the signed grant, plan, vesting history, exercise price, holder details and requested quantity. Compare records and identify post-termination, expiry or transfer restrictions for counsel to confirm.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review eligibility, cost and tax questions
parts.guidance: The holder and company obtain their own qualified advice on the actual instrument, jurisdiction and facts. Confirm the exercise method, available quantity and required approvals without promising liquidity or selecting a tax outcome for the holder.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review eligibility, cost and tax questions

parts.title: Prepare the approved exercise documents
parts.guidance: Populate the applicable exercise notice and calculation from verified terms. Record payment, withholding and evidence requirements and flag any difference between the grant and the company equity system.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Authorize and complete the exercise
parts.guidance: The holder and authorized company representatives review and execute the required documents. Authorized operators collect and verify the required consideration and approvals before recording an issuance; a submitted request is not completed ownership.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile issuance and follow-up obligations
parts.guidance: Match the signed exercise, payment and equity register, and retain the confirmation privately. Assign any tax, payroll or securities reporting to the appropriate advisers and update the cap table through its established process.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A verified exercise decision and, if completed, reconciled payment, issued equity and required reporting evidence.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

metadata.supportReason: An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.
